title: Fresh example with the owner unprepared
item: Fresh example built from scratch in the new format, with the owner answering the interview unprepared
motivation: Only fair test of the interview guard and of readability; the owner already knows Harbor Goods
notes: After reading the policy page: five questions about the policy, noting whether the chart was used. The chart stays only if it was used.
done_means: A new example is built in the new format from the owner's live interview. His five answers about the policy, and whether he used the chart, are recorded. The chart is kept or dropped.
